name: 312. BytePlus Seedream per-image refusals reach the client as content_filter (seedream content filter) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6605 regression, contract C5, C6. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The byteplus provider there points at /pp/byteplus, where the fixture answers /api/v3/images/generations with Ark's 200 shape: data[] mixing delivered images with per-image error objects (OutputImageSensitiveContentDetected), selected by model. A refused image is counted in content_filter, every image refused is still a 200 with data [], and a 200 with neither images nor refusals is 502 provider_empty_result. 312.4 and 312.5 pin the same on /v1/images/edits (multipart, with a reference image), and 312.4 also pins the resolution tier reaching Ark as size. 312.1 and 312.4 read the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire. 312.6 to 312.9 pin the other C6 path: Ark refusing over HTTP (400, InputTextSensitiveContentDetected) on generation and edit, streamed and not, must keep Ark's status and code and carry extra_fields.error_type caller_content_filtered; 312.10 is the control, an Ark 400 InvalidParameter that must not be classed as a content filter. 312.11 and 312.12 pin the in-stream path: Ark accepts a stream (generation and edit) with a 200 and refuses every image with image_generation.partial_failed events. No frame has reached the client, so the gateway answers with a JSON 400 carrying Ark's code, error.type content_filter and error_type caller_content_filtered. 312.13 to 312.18 pin error objects inside an Ark 200, on generation and edit: InternalServiceError as the only image is 502 provider_server_error, a top-level moderation error object is 400 caller_content_filtered, and a top-level parameter error object is 400 caller_invalid_request, each with Ark's code verbatim. 312.19 to 312.21 pin the same error objects on a stream: a top-level moderation error event is 400 caller_content_filtered on generation and edit, and an InternalServiceError image is provider_server_error. 312.22 pins a stream that completes with nothing delivered or refused as 502 provider_empty_result. Run the whole folder in order.
